notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Governing document: AFUM-UMS collective agreement 2015-2017 (2018_01), which covers the full-time faculty bargaining unit at all UMS universities including the University of Maine; expired June 30, 2017 and, per the document's version note, continued in force until the successor took effect March 29, 2018 (successor 2018_02 not coded). The UMS Labor Relations page (2018_07, capture 2018-04-23) lists 'AFUM Contract 2015-2017' and holds no policy (navigation and contract list only). Missing is false: a governing collective agreement for tenure-stream faculty leave is saved.

Summaries: the UMS HR 'Family Leave Policies' page (2018_00, 'Revised OHR 10/2015', capture 2018-04-19) is a system-wide summary for all employees that refers faculty to the collective agreement; the four ADVANCE Rising Tide guides (2018_03-06, August 2015) summarise the agreement. They supply the FMLA terms and details only; no provision is coded from them alone.

No employer-paid parental or childbirth leave exists in the saved documents: birth-related pay comes only from the member's own accrued disability (sick) leave (c4, c5, c6), the employee-paid short-term plan (c10) and LTD after six months (c9). Paid relief: one semester of alternatives-to-teaching duties at normal salary (c3).

Appendix K's MOU text states a period 'commencing September 1, 2008 and ending June 30, 2009'; Art. 19.D.4.d of the 2015-2017 agreement says the MOU is 'currently in effect at the University of Maine' and extends it to all universities, so it is read as in force.

Art. 9.B.3.a's condition 'which requires a full time absence from work for greater than 6 weeks' grammatically may qualify only 'any FMLA related event'; 9.B.3.c lets a member initiate a full-year extension without a leave of absence. Coded as available on birth or adoption.

Art. 19.H (c12) lets a faculty member returning mid-semester from any leave agree an alternate work assignment for the rest of the semester: general purpose (any leave), negotiated, undescribed relief.

HR summary only (not coded separately): the HR page's spouse or domestic-partner disability-leave limits (10 days, 20 days) apply to salaried and hourly staff; faculty use 30 days (c5). Lactation room and breast-pump coverage (2018_06) are not leave, pay, relief or protection. Return-to-work accommodations via Equal Opportunity (2018_05) are disability accommodations, not components.

Chain, birth parent: own disability leave (c4, own balance, within FMLA) and newborn-care disability leave 30 days (c5, within FMLA) -> alternatives-to-teaching relief one semester at normal salary (c3, consecutive_after c4 and c5); FMLA 12 weeks (c11) from the start; discretionary: additional 30 days (c6) after c5, medical LWOP up to 1 year (c8) after c4. Tenure clock one year (c1).

Chain, non-birth parent: newborn-care disability leave 30 days (c5, own balance, within FMLA) -> alternatives-to-teaching relief one semester (c3, consecutive_after c5; the c4 link is ignored for this role); FMLA 12 weeks (c11) from the start; discretionary: additional 30 days (c6) after c5. Tenure clock one year (c1).

Documents cited but not saved: AFUM agreement successor 2017-2019 (saved but excluded); MyUMS Portal paid-leave information; Short Term Disability summary plan description; Notification: Stopping the Tenure Clock for Purposes of Childrearing form; Request to Stop the Tenure Clock for Exceptional Life Circumstances form; Request for Alternatives to Teaching Duties form and the on-line list of Alternative Duties; faculty handbook (Appendix K); Maine Family Medical Leave Law text; Board of Trustees policies; Policy on Course Coverage (text included in Appendix K).
